classification.difficultyReason: Identify the radius directly from an origin-centred circle equation and sketch its four axis intercepts, including exact surd and fractional values.

content.prompt: Sketch the graph of the following.

answer.worked:
The centre is $(0,0)$.

$$\begin{align*}r^2&=1\\r&=1\end{align*}$$

Draw the circle through $(\pm1,0)$ and $(0,\pm1)$.
